convert_to_numpy: convert an array interface buffer to a NumPy NDArray with zero-copy semantics
convert_to_torch: convert an array interface or CUDA buffer to a PyTorch Tensor with zero-copy support
convert_to_numba: convert an array interface or CUDA buffer to a Numba DeviceNDArray or NumPy NDArray

review_ArrayInterface_protocol: review the ArrayInterface Protocol for objects implementing the NumPy array interface
